Metamask is a self-custodial crypto wallet that runs as a browser extension and as a mobile application. Metamask gives users direct control of their private keys rather than relying on a custodian. Metamask connects users to decentralized applications on Ethereum and other EVM-compatible blockchains.

Ledger is a hardware wallet that stores private keys offline on a dedicated physical device. Ledger is produced by the company Ledger SAS, which is based in France. Ledger signs blockchain transactions on the device so that keys are not exposed to a connected computer.

MakerDAO is a decentralized lending protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. MakerDAO issues the DAI stablecoin, which is backed by collateral deposited into smart contracts. MakerDAO is governed by holders of its MKR governance token, who vote on protocol parameters.

BNB Chain is a public blockchain that is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine. BNB Chain was formerly known as Binance Smart Chain. BNB Chain supports smart contracts that host decentralized finance applications.
